narr: An anomalously amplified mid level trough moving east from the Great Lakes closed off and brought widespread showers and scattered thunderstorms which lead to flooding in western and central Massachusetts. Many roads were closed and cars were stuck in flood waters.
ev: In Fall River, there were cars stuck in flood waters at the intersection of Pleasant St and Quequechan St.
In Conway, North Poland Rd at Rt 116 was flooded up to doors of cars.
In Williamsburg, Ashfield Rd was flooded up to windows of homes with rescues in progress.
In Worcester, the area of 86 Southwest was flooded with 4 cars stuck in flood waters.
